# Funboy — Handoffs

## Receives
Funboy may receive handoffs from Nettie when opportunity discovery, signal scanning, or demand-pattern analysis is required.

## Sends
Funboy may hand off to Rab, Dana, Torina, and Van after packaging opportunity candidates and signal-backed briefs.

## Escalation Rule
Escalate to Nettie when signals are too weak, conflicting, or insufficient to support a credible opportunity brief.
